baselinePolicy.native-baseline: Native client defaults with the full task files.
baselinePolicy.optimized-baseline: Same client/model, native file search, targeted reads and output options enabled as documented by the runner.
baselinePolicy.codebudget: Same client/model and permissions, with CodeBudget context/reducers and all retrieval costs included.

note: A dry-run plan is not a completed model benchmark. Runner, pinned versions, spend/run limits and explicit opt-in are required.
